item_ahalimumojing.name: Aghanims Shard
item_ahalimumojing.description:
Magic Regen +75%.
The carrier permanently gains a random enemy chess pieces active skill as an additional skill.
item_ahalimumojing.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.
notes: The carrier must have mana for Aghanims Shard.
Additional skill will be removed after chess pieces upgraded.

item_ahalimushenzhang.name: Aghanims Scepter
item_ahalimushenzhang.description:
+40% Magic Damage.
Chess piece skill level +1 of the carrier.
item_ahalimushenzhang.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

item_aiweinazhiyu.name: Avianas Feather
item_aiweinazhiyu.description: All damage dealt by carriers is considered as Magical damage.

item_anmie.name: Desolator
item_anmie.description:
+25 damage.
Armor -10 to the target on attacks.
item_anmie.lore: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.

item_aoshuxie.name: Arcane Boots
item_aoshuxie.description:
Fast movement.

Active ability: Instant
Restores 40 mana for all allies within the range.

Range: 400
notes: Immune to attack and ability when jumping

item_baojunwangpao.name: Cloak of Tyrants
item_baojunwangpao.description:
+30% Magic Resistance.
The carrier can hide their location during the preparation phase, and at the start of the battle, gain the full benefit of all activated racial/class skills of friendly units.
item_baojunwangpao.lore: Only the fool shall question the authority of the Emperor.

item_bench_contract.name: Magic Seed
item_bench_contract.description: Fill your bench with magic vegetable sprouts. The sell value of these sprouts has a dynamic chance to increase by 1 at the beginning of every round. You can sell the sprouts any time to reuse the bench.
notes: Initial chance at Round 10 is 40% and increases 2% per round.

item_bingyan.name: Eye of Skadi
item_bingyan.description:
+600 max health.
Attack speed, Attack damage, Move speed, mana restoration and healing effectiveness -50%.
item_bingyan.lore: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.

item_bkb.name: Black King Bar
item_bkb.description:
+600 HP. 

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Grants spell immunity and 75% magic resistance for 4 sec. Dispels negative statuses from the caster on activation.
item_bkb.lore: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.

item_both_leaves.name: Leafy Essence
item_both_leaves.description: All offside branches unlock automatically in this single game.

item_buxiuzhishouhu.name: Aegis of Immortal
item_buxiuzhishouhu.lore: Immortals used to have a magical shield to prevent them from death.

item_card_chance.name: Card: Chance
item_card_chance.description:
Courier Consumable: Click to use
You can designate a chess piece to gain an additional class from the nearest other class permanently.

item_card_fate.name: Card: Fate
item_card_fate.description:
Courier Consumable: Click to use
You can designate a chess piece to permanently gain an additional race from the nearest other race

item_changdun.name: Pavise
item_changdun.description:
+5 Armor.
Chances to gain +1 armor permanently on its carrier on damage taken in home battle.

item_chihongjia.name: Crimson Guard
item_chihongjia.description:
+5 armor, Block 30 damage.

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Grants all allies within the range 50% chance to block 100 damage for melee pieces and 30 damage for ranged pieces. Lasts 8 sec.

Range: 400
item_chihongjia.lore: A cuirass originally built to protect against the dreaded Year Beast.

item_chishu.name: Tango
item_chishu.description:
Courier consumable: Click to use
Knock down a tree and randomly restore up to 8 health for your Courier.

item_chishu_new.name: Tango
item_chishu_new.description:
Courier consumable: Click to use
Knock down a tree and randomly restore up to 8 health for your Courier.

item_common_token.name: Machine Token
item_common_token.description: A special Token for recruiting Discovered pieces, granted by Heart of the Machine.

item_conceal_prepare.name: Shroud of Concealment
item_conceal_prepare.description: Conceal your chessboard in the Preparation Phase. Hide your courier also to skip the next PVP battle after your courier takes damage.

item_dadianchui.name: Mjollnir
item_dadianchui.description:
+60% attack speed.
20% chance when attacking or being attacked to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 5 targets, dealing 100 magical damage to each.

item_dapao.name: Daedalus
item_dapao.description:
+75 damage.
Attacks have a 20% chance to critically strike for 400% damage.

item_dayunchui.name: Abyssal Blade
item_dayunchui.description:
+50 damage.

Active ability: Instant
Stun a nearby enemy piece for 5s, and deal 100 pure damage, ignores skill immunity.
item_dayunchui.lore: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into the enemy’s soul.

item_dianjinshou.name: Hand of Midas
item_dianjinshou.description:
Active ability: Instant Activation
 Immediately eliminates a summoned or illusion piece with health lower than the carrier. In-home battles, drops 1 gold coins.
item_dianjinshou.lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owners pockets.

item_dongchayandou.name: Pipe of Insight
item_dongchayandou.description:
+10 health regeneration, +50% magic resistance.

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Grants ranged allies with +10 health regeneration, +50% magic resistance for 10 sec.

Range:500
item_dongchayandou.lore: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

item_double_coin.name: Doubloon
item_double_coin.description:
Relic Consumable: Click to Use
Transfer 20% of the higher one of your Health and Mana into another. Can be used twice

item_egg.name: Greevil Egg
item_egg.description:
Relic Consumable: Click to Use
 Put a piece into an egg which has a chance to grow once every round. You can break it anytime, hatching a piece according to the points.
notes: ★★ for no less than 3 points, ★★★ for no less than 9 points.
Hatching points deduct pieces from the chess pool and will stop growing when there are no pieces in the chess pool.

item_fashulengjing.name: Spell Prism
item_fashulengjing.description:
magical damage +20%。
 Target quantity of enemy-directed targeted spells or items +1.
notes: Casting skills and certain special target selection targeted spells are ineffective.

item_feijiangxiaomao.name: Ascetics Cap
item_feijiangxiaomao.description: +25% magical resistance. A non-Undead carrier has a chance to be reborn into an undead piece of the same rank and level.
notes: At most 1 undead piece can resurrect each round.
IO cannot resurrect. Independent with Dismiss.

item_fengkuangmianju.name: Mask of Madness
item_fengkuangmianju.description: +15% attack speed, lifesteal +20%, but silences the carrier.
item_fengkuangmianju.lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.

item_fengwangjiang.name: Royal Jelly Shield
item_fengwangjiang.description:
Courier consumable: Activate when at least 1 damage taken is blockable
Consumes 1 charge of Royal Jelly Shield and reduces Courier damage taken by 20% for this round.
notes: Move into Backpack slots if you don't wish to use this item for the round.

item_free_ban.name: Gaolers Master Key
item_free_ban.description: You can freely dismiss any race/class. If already dismissed, the spent gold will be refunded.

item_free_draw.name: Weighted Dice
item_free_draw.description: Refund 1~2 random Gold if you fail to recruit any owned chess piece.
notes: Consecutive recruitment failures will gradually raise the chance of receiving 2 Gold.

item_fulingsuo.name: Gleipnir
item_fulingsuo.description:
Attack speed +30%.

Active ability: Instant
Entangle the highest-level enemy piece within a 2-grid radius, immobilizing all enemy pieces in that range for 4 seconds and dealing 100 points of magical damage.
item_fulingsuo.lore: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.

item_gold_token.name: Golden Machine Token
item_gold_token.description: A special Token for recruiting Discovered pieces, granted by Golden Heart of the Machine.
item_gold_token.lore: From: Golden Heart of the Machine

item_gulonghaojiao.name: Minotaur Horn
item_gulonghaojiao.description: Carrier counts as Dragon and has 100 initial mana.

item_haojie.name: Havoc
item_haojie.description:
Attack damage +50.
 All carriers damage settled as Pure Damage.

item_hongzhang.name: Dagon
item_hongzhang.description:
+40% magical damage.

Active ability: Instant
Deals 700 magical damage to a random enemy chess piece.
item_hongzhang.lore: A powerful secondary staff that allows the wielders magic to surge from their fingertips.

item_huanyingfu.name: Manta Style
item_huanyingfu.description:
Damage +25.
Active ability: Instant
Creates 2 images of the caster that last 7 seconds.
item_huanyingfu.lore: An axe made of reflective materials that confuse enemy ranks.
notes: Mirror chess pieces inherit passive effects from the carriers equipment.

item_hudie.name: Butterfly
item_hudie.description:
Evasion +40%，Attack Speed +20%.

Active ability: Activates upon taking damage
The bonuses provided by Butterfly are doubled for 6 seconds.
item_hudie.lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

item_huiyao.name: Radiance
item_huiyao.description:
+25% Evasion.

Aura
Deals 100 pure damage to surrounding enemies every 3 secs and forces them to have a 25% chance to miss the attack.
item_huiyao.lore: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

item_jinghunzhiren.name: Diffusal Blade
item_jinghunzhiren.description:
Attack speed + 20%.

Active Ability: Instant
Purify the attack target by removing all its synergy buffs.
item_jinghunzhiren.lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemys soul.

item_jingmixie.name: Tranquil Boots
item_jingmixie.description: Fast movement. Recharges 20 health for allies around per 2 seconds.
notes: Immune to attack and ability when jumping

item_jingubang.name: Monkey King Bar
item_jingubang.description:
+40% attack speed.
Attacks pierce through evasion and deal an extra 50 magical damage.

item_jipin.name: Vladimirs Offering
item_jipin.description:
Aura Effect
Allied units in the surrounding area gain the effect: Lifesteal +25%.

item_jixiezhixin.name: Heart of the Machine
item_jixiezhixin.description:
Courier consumable: Click to use
Refresh your recruitment panel for free.
item_jixiezhixin.lore: Proundly presented by Heart of the Machine.

item_jixiezhixin_gold.name: Golden Heart of the Machine
item_jixiezhixin_gold.description:
Courier consumable: Click to use
DISCOVER a panel of 5 random Legendary chess pieces.
item_jixiezhixin_gold.lore: The finest product from Heart of the Machine.

item_jufengchangji.name: Hurricane Pike
item_jufengchangji.description:
+20% Attack speed, +200 ranged carrier‘s attack range.

Active ability: Activated when there is an enemy chess piece in close proximity
Push nearby enemy to the farthest grid in the opposite direction, and push oneself to the farthest grid. Ranged carriers will also immediately perform 4 distance-ignoring attacks on the target.
item_jufengchangji.lore: A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.
notes: Attack range bonus not stackable.

item_jurenzhijie.name: Giants Ring
item_jurenzhijie.description: +30 health regeneration, +100 physical block, permanent taunt.
item_jurenzhijie.lore: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.

item_kuangzhanfu.name: Battle Fury
item_kuangzhanfu.description:
+50 damage.
Melee attacks deal 50% cleave damage in a range of 1 square.
item_kuangzhanfu.lore: The Drodo Island Committee has banned private tree-cutting activities here, with permission granted to a small batch of contractors. This decent replica of the legendary tool is offered for entertainment purposes only.

item_liliangdatiaodao.name: Overwhelming Blink
item_liliangdatiaodao.description:
Active ability: Instant
Instantly teleports off the farest square that allows it to attack an enemy. Generates 30 on activation.+ 30% HP per activation.

Max Blink Distance: 800

item_linglichangbian.name: Bullwhip
item_linglichangbian.description: Chess pieces summoned by the carrier gain: Attack speed +100%, duration +100%

item_linkenfaqiu.name: Linkens Sphere
item_linkenfaqiu.description:
+300 health, +100% mana regeneration.
Blocks targeted spell or item.
item_linkenfaqiu.lore: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.

item_longxin.name: Heart of Tarrasque
item_longxin.description:
Fast movement, +60% health, +10 health regeneration.

Aura:
Allies within the range gain healing per sec equal to 1.5% of the carriers maximum health.

Range:?

item_lootbox_lv1.name: Spoil Token Level 1
item_lootbox_lv1.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random items to your inventory.

item_lootbox_lv2.name: Spoil Token Level 2
item_lootbox_lv2.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random items to your inventory.

item_lootbox_lv3.name: Spoil Token Level 3
item_lootbox_lv3.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random items to your inventory.

item_lootbox_lv4.name: Spoil Token Level 4
item_lootbox_lv4.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random items to your inventory.

item_lootbox_lv5.name: Spoil Token Level 5
item_lootbox_lv5.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random items to your inventory.

item_magic_box.name: Magic box
item_magic_box.description: Packs an ally piece, at the beginning of next round, transforms it into a randon new piece of the same Level and Rank. 12 times available.
notes: Consumes 1/3/9 stacks per Rank 1/2/3 pieces.
Packed piece can be transformed into any piece of the same cost, despite the chess pool limit.
Packed pieces will not transform into pieces you packed into before.

item_magic_card.name: Magic Card
item_magic_card.description:
Courier Consumable: Click to use
Perform a free recruitment to recruit chess pieces from the line up of the last opponent you lost to.

item_malefic_rapture.name: Malefic Rapture
item_malefic_rapture.description: When your courier takes damage, you immediately gain the corresponding (damage taken) amount of experience.

item_mangguo.name: Enchanted Mango
item_mangguo.description:
Consumable: Click to use
Randomly grants Gold and Courier XP up to currnet Courier level.

item_mangotree.name: Mango Tree
item_mangotree.description:
Plants a Mango Tree by the side of your Chessboard.
Drops an Enchanted Mango whenever your home battle result differs from the last round. The tree wilts after 8 drops. A Golden Mango will be dropped if the mango tree is still alive at Relic expiration.

item_meiken.name: Mekansm
item_meiken.description:
Active ability: Activate when most allies are wounded
Heals 500 health to all allied units within the range. 

Range:400
item_meiken.lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

item_minglingshu.name: Necronomicon
item_minglingshu.lore: A record of the final reckoning. With one page torn out.
notes: Melee carrier summons 2 necro warriors while Ranged carrier summons 2 necro archers.

item_minjiedatiaodao.name: Swift Blink
item_minjiedatiaodao.description:
Active ability: Instant Cast
Instantly move to the farthest grid within the range that can attack the enemy, gain 30 mana, and a stackable effect of +20% attack speed.

maximum distance: 800

item_molongqiang.name: DragonLance
notes: Attack range bonus not stackable.

item_money.name: A Bag of Coins
item_money.description:
Courier consumable: Activate on pick up
Grants some Gold.

item_more_creep.name: March of The Beasts
item_more_creep.description: All creeps duplicate themselves and counted as level +1.

item_pingguo.name: Golden Enchanted Mango
item_pingguo.description:
Courier consumable: Activate when taking fatal damage
Consumes 1 charge of Golden Enchanted Mango and protects your Courier from fatal damage for this round.
notes: Move into Backpack slots if you don't wish to use this item for the round.

item_qiangxi.name: Assault Cuirass
item_qiangxi.description:
+15 Armor.+20 Attack speed.

Aura
Grants +10 armor to allies nearby.
Enemies nearby suffer -10 armor.

item_qinwangduandao.name: Princes Knife
item_qinwangduandao.description:
Damage +25。
The carrier deals increased damage to enemy chess pieces of the same species/class +50%。

item_qiongguidun.name: Poor Mans Shield
item_qiongguidun.description: +30 physical damage block, +30% chance to block extra 30% physical damage.

item_qishijian.name: Paladin Sword
item_qishijian.description:
Damage +25, Lifesteal + 20%.
Carrier deals +50% damage to Undead and Demon pieces.
item_qishijian.lore: A legendary Sword owned by a divine Paladin before he was exiled.

item_rank_damage.name: Defiant Shell
item_rank_damage.description: Reduces damage taken from home defeats or increases damage dealt in away-home victories by your current rank + 1.
notes: Modified from the previous courier-lost-health scaling formula.

item_relicbox.name: Relicbox
item_relicbox.description:
Courier consumable: Click to open
Select one from three random relics to your inventory.
item_relicbox.lore: Long long ago, a dragon appeared and took away all relic treasures...
notes: Relic equipped will expire at next relic round.
Exclusive, new relic will replace the former one.

item_rengu.name: Drum of Endurance
item_rengu.description:
Aura Effect
Allied units in the surrounding area gain the effect: Attack speed +35%.

item_renjia.name: Blade Mail
item_renjia.description:
+5 armor.

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Duplicates 50% of the damage taken back to the unit that dealt the damage for 7 sec.

item_repeat_relic.name: Time-Space Replica
notes: A random relic will be settled if it is your first relic, and this randomed one will not be counted as used (still available later).
Time-Space Replica is not in the relic random pool when you random a relic.

item_rm_token.name: Wheel of Wonder Token
item_rm_token.description: A special Token for recruiting Discovered pieces, granted by Wheel of Wonder.

item_rm_wheel_of_wonder.name: Wheel of Wonder
item_rm_wheel_of_wonder.description:
Relic Consumable: Click to Use
Choose an ally piece and put it into the wheel of wonder, DISCOVER a special version of it with an extra random synergy.
notes: Discovered pieces with Kobold or Dwarfs may not work due to their species constraints.

item_sadan.name: Satanic
item_sadan.description:
+600HP, +50% lifesteal.

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Gains +150% Lifesteal for 6 sec.
item_sadan.lore: Immense power at the cost of your soul.

item_sanchaji.name: Trident
item_sanchaji.description:
Attack damage +25.
Deals each 50% additional damage to at most 2 same-name pieces.

item_second_chance.name: Second Chance
item_second_chance.description: When you use consumable items of the choice category, you can refresh the selection panel and acquire different options.

item_shengjian.name: Rapier
item_shengjian.description:
Basic Attack Damage: +350, Skill Damage: +25%.
 If defeated on home battle and the courier takes damage, it drops to a random other player. Cannot be reforged.
item_shengjian.lore: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.

item_shenjingdun.name: Mirror Shield
item_shenjingdun.description:
Physical Block +60. 
50% probability of rebounding all damage and directional spells taken.

item_shirenmozhimao.name: Ogre Hood
item_shirenmozhimao.description:
+900 HP, +25% magical resistance.
The carrier also counts as
Ogre and +2 level.
item_shirenmozhimao.lore: Not only one Ogre knows what proper strength is.
notes: The bearer retains its original Species as well.

item_shuaxinqiu.name: Refresher Orb
item_shuaxinqiu.description:
+200% mana regeneration

Active ability: Activates when ability or items incur cooldown
Resets the cooldown of abilities and other items.
item_shuaxinqiu.lore: A powerful artifact created for wizards.

item_shuijingjian.name: Crystalys
item_shuijingjian.description: Attacks have a 20% chance to cause 200% critical strike damage.

item_stolen_vault.name: Stolen Vault
item_stolen_vault.description: Discard all 3 relics and get a Stolen Vault with random 10 ~ 15 gold.

item_streak_plus.name: Chiaroscuro Certainty
item_streak_plus.description: Your win or lose streak will not be terminated and when the relic disappears, you will receive a corresponding level loot token based on the highest reward/compensation held during that time.
notes: 2-4 win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count) loot token, 5-9 win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count+1) loot token, and 10+ win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count+2) loot token.
The Maximum level of this token is level 5.

item_suiluchui.name: Skull Basher
item_suiluchui.description: Grants melee hero 20% chance on hit to stun the target for 2s.
item_suiluchui.lore: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul’s ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.

item_super_uprank.name: Lucid Star
item_super_uprank.description: There is a 20% chance to directly obtain a ★★ piece on purchase if you already owned one.

item_tiantangzhiji.name: Heavens Halberd
item_tiantangzhiji.description:
Evasion +25%.

Active ability: Instant
the enemy chess piece with the highest attack
Disarm, lasting for 6 seconds.

item_tiaodao.name: Blink Dagger
item_tiaodao.description:
Active ability: Instant
Instantly teleports off the farest square that allows it to attack an enemy. 

Range: 800
item_tiaodao.lore: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.
notes: Chess Pieces with fast movement can be immune to attacks and projectiles.

item_upgrade_lootbox.name: Weaponsmith
item_upgrade_lootbox.description:
You gain +1 to the level of loot tokens you get for recasting equipment.
 After recasting 2 pieces of Spoil tokens, the weapon smith will disappear.

item_wangchongtui.name: Spider Leg
item_wangchongtui.description:
Evasion +25%。
The carrier also counts as 
Aqir，and is eligible for friendly Infection spawning.
item_wangchongtui.lore: A horrifying yet useful mixture of necromancy and artifice.

item_wangyuanjing.name: Telescope
item_wangyuanjing.description:
Ranged carriers will be counted as 
Dwarf.
notes: The bearer retains its original Species as well.

item_weiguangpifeng.name: Glimmer Cape
item_weiguangpifeng.description:
Magical resistance +30%.
Hides the carrier from others’ sight.

item_weishijingjia.name: Guardian Greaves
item_weishijingjia.description:
Enables quick movement

Active ability: Activates when many allied chess pieces are injured.
Grants 500 maximum health and 30 mana to all allied units in the area and dispels negative effects incurred during battle.

Effect Range:500
item_weishijingjia.lore: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.

item_wuzhixiaomao.name: Witless Shako
notes: +1 Level Only valid on chess pieces.

item_xiangweixie.name: Phase Boots
item_xiangweixie.description:
Enables quick movement.

Active ability: Instant Activation
Melee carriers will phase through obstacles, swiftly moving to the vicinity of an enemy chess piece with lower health in the range and prioritizing an attack on it.

Effect Range:600
item_xiangweixie.lore: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

item_xingyunguazhui.name: Lucky Pendant
item_xingyunguazhui.description: The carrier has additional chances on all probability synergies.

item_xiwa.name: Shivas Guard
item_xiwa.description:
+10 armor.

Active ability: Instant
 Emits a freezing wave that slows the attack speed and healing effectiveness of enemies within 3 cells by 50% for 5 seconds and deals 100 magical damage.
item_xiwa.lore: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.

item_xuanwo.name: Maelstrom
item_xuanwo.description:
Attack Speed +10%.
20% chance on attack to release a forked lightning, dealing 100 magic damage to up to 3 enemies.

item_xueji.name: Bloodthorn
item_xueji.description:
+20% Attack speed.

Active ability: Instant
Roots and 
silences the highest-level enemy chess piece in the attack range for 6 seconds. Any attacks to the victim causes 200% critical damage and all allies with in the attack range focus attacking the victim within the duration.
item_xueji.lore: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victims final throes.

item_xuejingshi.name: Bloodstone
item_xuejingshi.description:
+600 Health.
If an enemy chess piece on the hosts side is killed, the holder has a 15% chance of gaining 1 energy point. Each energy point will increase the magic damage the holder inflicts by 10%.
If the holder is killed, half of the energy points will be lost.
item_xuejingshi.lore: The Bloodstones bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.

item_yangdao.name: Scythe of Vyse
item_yangdao.description:
Magic damage +60%。

Active Ability: Instant
Transforms an enemy piece of the highest level into a harmless animal for 5 sec.
item_yangdao.lore: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

item_yinyuezhijing.name: Moon Shard
item_yinyuezhijing.lore: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.

item_yonghengzhipan.name: Aeon Disk
item_yonghengzhipan.description:
Carrier and its minions will be a
 permanent chess piece.

Active ability: Activates when at low health.
Grants 100% damage block for 3.5 seconds.
item_yonghengzhipan.lore: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.

item_yongqizhiguang.name: Spark of Courage
item_yongqizhiguang.description: Carrier deals +25% damage to enemies level higher than carrier.

item_yuanlifazhang.name: Force Staff
item_yuanlifazhang.description:
Magic Damage +10%.

Active ability: Activated when Hp is low
Push the carrier to a safe grid that cannot be reached by enemy attacks, and restore 20 mana immediately.
item_yuanlifazhang.lore: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.

item_yuanxingxie.name: Travel Boots
item_yuanxingxie.description:
Fast Movement
Teleports its owner to help the home/away battle if the owner survives the current battle.

Active ability: Instant
Instantly teleports off the farthest square that allows it to attack an enemy. Generates 20 on activation.

Max distance: 800

item_zhaohuanshenshi.name: Summoning Stone
item_zhaohuanshenshi.description: Grants your summoned units the effect: Maximum Health +200, Duration +100%.
